程序包 org.bukkit.help

类 HelpTopic

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.help.HelpTopic
直接已知子类:
GenericCommandHelpTopic, IndexHelpTopic
public abstract class HelpTopic extends Object
HelpTopic implementations are displayed to the user when the user uses the /help command.

Custom implementations of this class can work at two levels. A simple implementation only needs to set the value of name, shortText, and fullText in the constructor. This base class will take care of the rest.

Complex implementations can be created by overriding the behavior of all the methods in this class. 当用户使用 /help 命令时，HelpTopic 的实现会展示给用户。

此类的自定义实现可以在两个层面上工作。简单实现只需在构造器中设置 name、shortText 和 fullText 的值，基类会处理其余部分。

复杂实现可以通过覆写此类中的所有方法来创建。

    • canSee

      public abstract boolean canSee(CommandSender player)
      Determines if a Player is allowed to see this help topic.

      HelpTopic implementations should take server administrator wishes into account as set by the amendCanSee(String) function. 判断某个 Player 是否被允许查看此帮助主题。

      HelpTopic 实现应将 amendCanSee(String) 函数所设置的服务器管理员意愿纳入考虑。

      参数:
      player - The Player in question. 所讨论的 Player。
      返回:
      True of the Player can see this help topic, false otherwise. 若该 Player 能看到此帮助主题则为 true，否则为 false。

    • amendCanSee

      public void amendCanSee(String amendedPermission)
      Allows the server administrator to override the permission required to see a help topic.

      HelpTopic implementations should take this into account when determining topic visibility on the canSee(org.bukkit.command.CommandSender) function. 允许服务器管理员覆写查看帮助主题所需的权限。

      HelpTopic 实现在 canSee(org.bukkit.command.CommandSender) 函数中确定主题可见性时应将此纳入考虑。

      参数:
      amendedPermission - The permission node the server administrator 服务器管理员希望应用到该主题的权限节点。 wishes to apply to this topic.

    • getFullText

      public String getFullText(CommandSender forWho)
      Returns the full description of this help topic that is displayed when the user requests this topic's details.

      The result will be paginated to properly fit the user's client. 返回此帮助主题的完整描述，在用户请求该主题的详情时显示。

      结果将被分页以适当地适配用户的客户端。

      参数:
      forWho - The player or console requesting the full text. Useful 请求完整文本的玩家或控制台。可用于在自定义实现中基于子权限进一步裁剪命令的完整文本。 for further security trimming the command's full text based on sub-permissions in custom implementations.
      返回:
      A full topic description. 完整的主题描述。

    • amendTopic

      public void amendTopic(String amendedShortText, String amendedFullText)
      Allows the server admin (or another plugin) to add or replace the contents of a help topic.

      A null in either parameter will leave that part of the topic unchanged. In either amending parameter, the string <text> is replaced with the existing contents in the help topic. Use this to append or prepend additional content into an automatically generated help topic. 允许服务器管理员（或其他插件）添加或替换帮助主题的内容。

      任一参数为 null 将保持主题该部分不变。在任一修订参数中，字符串 <text> 会被替换为帮助主题中的现有内容。可利用这一点向自动生成的帮助主题追加或前置额外内容。

      参数:
      amendedShortText - The new topic short text to use, or null to 要使用的新主题短文本，传 null 则保持不变。 leave alone.
      amendedFullText - The new topic full text to use, or null to leave 要使用的新主题完整文本，传 null 则保持不变。 alone.

    • applyAmendment

      protected String applyAmendment(String baseText, String amendment)
      Developers implementing their own custom HelpTopic implementations can use this utility method to ensure their implementations comply with the expected behavior of the amendTopic(String, String) method. 实现自定义 HelpTopic 的开发者可以使用此工具方法，确保其实现符合 amendTopic(String, String) 方法的预期行为。
      参数:
      baseText - The existing text of the help topic. 帮助主题的现有文本。
      amendment - The amending text from the amendTopic() method. 来自 amendTopic() 方法的修订文本。
      返回:
      The application of the amending text to the existing text, 按照 amendTopic() 的预期规则将修订文本应用到现有文本的结果。 according to the expected rules of amendTopic().
